title.zh: 更新互动消息应用信息（旧版）

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

The single-user QPS limit for this API is 100 queries per second (QPS). API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. You can call this API at a reasonable rate. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-message-app --app-id VKL3000 --app-name testApp --app-config key=example-string --extension key=example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live UpdateMessageApp --region cn-hangzhou --Extension '{"key":"example-string"}' --AppConfig '{"key":"example-string"}' --AppId VKL3000 --AppName testApp
